name: Chengdu Sharp Sensing
name_zh: 成都锐觉传感技术有限公司
summary: Chengdu Sharp Sensing develops biomimetic electronic skin and flexible tactile sensors for robots. Its robotics portfolio includes fingertip and industrial gripper sensors and an electronic-skin module for companion robots and interactive toys.
